text: 请不要现在付款，等我确认后再付。
must_preserve: Do not pay now; wait for my confirmation.

text: 我们改到明天下午三点开会，不是今天。
must_preserve: Meeting moved to 3 p.m. tomorrow, not today.

text: 方便的话，能请您今天下班前发我一份报价吗？
must_preserve: Polite conditional request for a quotation before end of work today.

text: 如果周五还没收到货，我们就取消订单。
must_preserve: Cancellation conditional on not receiving goods by Friday.

text: 我还没确认，不代表我不同意。
must_preserve: Not having confirmed yet does not mean disagreement.

text: 请把订单AB-2026发给Alex，不要发给Alice。
must_preserve: Order AB-2026 to Alex, explicitly not Alice.

text: 先发两箱，每箱12件，剩下的下周再发。
must_preserve: Two boxes first, twelve items each, remainder next week.

text: 我这边刚忙完，晚点给你回电话，可以吗？
must_preserve: Just finished being busy; asks whether calling later is okay.

text: 这个价格可能还会调整，我现在不能保证。
must_preserve: Price may change and cannot currently be guaranteed.

text: 北京时间10月20日上午9点，也就是伦敦时间凌晨2点。
must_preserve: Preserve given October 20 09:00 Beijing and 02:00 London; do not silently recalculate.

text:
第一批已经发出。

第二批还没发，请不要重复下单。
must_preserve: First batch shipped, second not yet; do not place duplicate order; preserve paragraphs.
